debug_loglevel.description: Log verbosity level (0–9). Set to 0 in production for minimal logging.

spam_tag_level.description: Spam score threshold to add 'X-Spam-Status' and 'X-Spam-Level' headers.

spam_tag2_level.description: Spam score threshold to add '*** SPAM ***' prefix to the subject line.

spam_kill_level.description: Spam score threshold at which messages are discarded or quarantined (depending on $final_spam_destiny).

domain.description: Domain name used for the virus admin (bounces, notifications).

sql_database.description: Name of the MySQL/PostgreSQL database used for amavisd policy lookup (e.g., users, domains, whitelist).

sql_host.description: Hostname or IP of the SQL server.

sql_port.description: TCP port of the SQL server (3306 for MySQL, 5432 for PostgreSQL).

sql_user.description: Database username for amavisd to connect.

sql_pass.description: Password for the SQL user. Keep secure; do not commit to config repo.

max_message_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of messages to scan. Larger messages are skipped.

max_workers.description: Number of concurrent worker processes (preforking model). Adjust based on CPU and load.

timeout_fork.description: Timeout (in seconds) for external helper processes (e.g., clamd, spamc).

trusted_networks.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR subnets (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24') that are trusted — spam checks are bypassed for them.

items.description: IP address or subnet (IPv4 or IPv6) allowed to bypass spam checks.
